questions.question: Whom does Psalm 132 ask the LORD to remember?
options: Solomon and the building of the temple
Moses and the years in the desert

questions.question: What did the LORD swear to David?
options: That he would subdue all the nations before him
That he would grant him a very long and peaceful life
That he would set one of his offspring on his throne
That he would give him riches beyond measure
questions.answer: That he would set one of his offspring on his throne

questions.question: The psalm recalls David's vow to find a dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob.
The LORD swore to David a sure oath from which he will not turn back: 'One of the fruit of your body I will set on your _____.'
For the LORD has chosen _____; he has desired it for his dwelling place.
